title: Shift lever and direction lever impressions
summary: Feedback in this topic spans a liked turn-direction display plus criticism of shift-lever response and dislike of another direction lever, with some preference comments that do not clearly resolve into sentiment about a specific feature outcome.

positive.summary: The positive review praises how the next turn or direction step is displayed.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize slow deceleration response when using the shift lever and dislike the airflow direction lever.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews express preference for a physical or sequential-style shift lever over paddles, but the examples are insufficient to classify a clear sentiment outcome for the feature discussed.

limitations: This topic appears to mix at least two subjects: navigation direction display, shifting controls, and an airflow direction lever.
The sample is small, and the undetermined examples are preference statements without enough context to classify a clearer sentiment.
The fragments are sentiment-stratified samples and are not representative estimates of overall customer experience.
